name: tab-menu-horizontal
title: Tab Menu Horizontal
description: A horizontal pill-shaped tab menu with selected/unselected states, icon and counter support. Uses namespace exports: TabMenuHorizontal.Root, TabMenuHorizontal.Item, TabMenuHorizontal.Icon, TabMenuHorizontal.Counter, TabMenuHorizontal.Composed.

docs.lead: A horizontal pill-shaped tab menu with selected/unselected states. Supports neutral and primary variants, icons, number counter badges, and a composed shorthand.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Neutral variant with dark selected state.
examples.code: setSelected('overview')}> Overview setSelected('details')}> Details

examples.title: Primary
examples.description: Primary variant using the brand color for the selected tab.

examples.title: With Icons
examples.description: Tabs with leading icons using the polymorphic Icon subcomponent.

examples.title: With Counter
examples.description: Tabs with a red number counter badge, matching the design system badge pattern.

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Shorthand composed version with controlled value and optional count.
examples.code:
<TabMenuHorizontal.Composed
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  items={[
    { label: 'Overview', value: 'overview', icon: RiHome5Line },
    { label: 'Profile', value: 'profile', icon: RiUserLine, count: 5 },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Overflow
examples.description: When tabs exceed the container width, the menu scrolls horizontally.

api.name: TabMenuHorizontal.Root
api.description: Container for tab items with tablist role.

api.name: TabMenuHorizontal.Item
api.description: Individual tab button with pill shape.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether this tab is currently selected

api.name: TabMenuHorizontal.Icon
api.description: Polymorphic icon inside a tab item.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as

api.name: TabMenuHorizontal.Counter
api.description: Red number badge inside a tab item. Hidden when count is 0 or less. Shows '99+' for values over 99.

api.name: TabMenuHorizontal.Composed
api.description: Shorthand controlled tab menu. Accepts all Root props.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when a tab is clicked

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; value: string; disabled?: boolean; icon?: React.ElementType; count?: number }[]
